arxiv-2106-06051.title: The Power of Two Choices in Graphical Allocation
arxiv-2106-06051.creator: Nikhil Bansal, Ohad Feldheim
arxiv-2106-06051.description: Abstract The graphical balls-into-bins process is a generalization of the classical 2-choice balls-into-bins process, where the bins correspond to vertices of an arbitrary underlying graph G G . At each time step an edge of G G is chosen uniformly at random, and a ball must be assigned to either of the two endpoints of this edge.

arxiv-2108-06361.title: On tempered fractional calculus with respect to functions and the associated fractional differential equations
arxiv-2108-06361.creator: Ashwini D. Mali, Kishor D. Kucche, Arran Fernandez, Hafiz Muhammad Fahad
arxiv-2108-06361.description: Abstract The prime aim of the present paper is to continue developing the theory of tempered fractional integrals and derivatives of a function with respect to another function. This theory combines the tempered fractional calculus with the Ψ \Psi -fractional calculus, both of which have found applications in topics including continuous time random walks.

arxiv-2305-14471.title: CGCE: A Chinese Generative Chat Evaluation Benchmark for General and Financial Domains
arxiv-2305-14471.creator: Xuanyu Zhang, Bingbing Li and Qing Yang
arxiv-2305-14471.description: Abstract Generative chat models, such as ChatGPT and GPT-4, have revolutionized natural language generation (NLG) by incorporating instructions and human feedback to achieve significant performance improvements. However, the lack of standardized evaluation benchmarks for chat models, particularly for Chinese and domain-specific models, hinders their assessment and progress.

arxiv-2309-02494.title: Supermassive black hole wake or bulgeless edge-on galaxy?
arxiv-2309-02494.creator: J. Sánchez Almeida
arxiv-2309-02494.description: Abstract Context. A recently discovered thin long object aligned with a nearby galaxy could be the stellar wake induced by the passage of a supermassive black hole (SMBH) kicked out from the nearby galaxy by the slingshot effect of a three-body encounter of SMBHs. Alternatively, the object could be a bulgeless edge-on galaxy coincidentally aligned with a second nearby companion.

arxiv-2409-13158.title: High-Fidelity Mask-free Neural Surface Reconstruction for Virtual Reality
arxiv-2409-13158.creator: Haotian Bai HKUST(GZ), Yize Chen University of Alberta, Lin Wang HKUST(GZ) HKUST
arxiv-2409-13158.description: Abstract Object-centric surface reconstruction from multi-view images plays a crucial role in creating editable digital assets for AR/VR. Due to the lack of geometric constraints, existing methods, e.g. , NeuS [ 38 ] necessitate annotating the object masks to reconstruct compact surfaces in mesh processing.

arxiv-2411-13081.title: Practical Compact Deep Compressed Sensing
arxiv-2411-13081.creator: Bin Chen, Jian Zhang
arxiv-2411-13081.description: Abstract Recent years have witnessed the success of deep networks in compressed sensing (CS), which allows for a significant reduction in sampling cost and has gained growing attention since its inception. In this paper, we propose a new practical and compact network dubbed PCNet for general image CS.

arxiv-2503-14813.title: Scaled Supervision is an Implicit Lipschitz Regularizer
arxiv-2503-14813.creator: Zhongyu Ouyang, Chunhui Zhang, Yaning Jia, Soroush Vosoughi
arxiv-2503-14813.description: Abstract In modern social media, recommender systems (RecSys) rely on the click-through rate (CTR) as the standard metric to evaluate user engagement. CTR prediction is traditionally framed as a binary classification task to predict whether a user will interact with a given item.

arxiv-2504-20084.title: AI Awareness
arxiv-2504-20084.creator: Xiaojian Li, Haoyuan Shi, Rongwu Xu, Wei Xu
arxiv-2504-20084.description: Abstract Recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) have brought about increasingly capable systems that demonstrate remarkable abilities in reasoning, language understanding, and problem-solving. These advancements have prompted a renewed examination of AI awareness —not as a philosophical question of consciousness, but as a measurable, functional capacity.

arxiv-2601-17084.title: ChemNavigator: Agentic AI Discovery of Design Rules for Organic Photocatalysts
arxiv-2601-17084.creator: Iman Peivaste, Ahmed Makradi, Salim Belouettar
arxiv-2601-17084.description: Abstract The discovery of high-performance organic photocatalysts for hydrogen evolution remains limited by the vastness of chemical space and the reliance on human intuition for molecular design. Here we present ChemNavigator, an agentic AI system that autonomously derives structure-property relationships through hypothesis-driven exploration of organic photocatalyst candidates.

pmc-11320885.title: Sociocultural perceptions of physical activity and dietary habits for hypertension control: voices from adults in a rural sub-district of South Africa
pmc-11320885.creator: Kganetso Sekome, Francesc Xavier Gómez-Olivé, Lauren B Sherar, Dale W Esliger, Hellen Myezwa
pmc-11320885.description: BackgroundOver half of adults from rural South Africa are hypertensive. Apart from pharmaceutical treatment, lifestyle changes such as increasing physical activity and reducing dietary salt have been strongly advocated for the control of hypertension. However, the control rates of hypertension for adults in rural South Africa are low.

pmc-11367772.title: Impact of a school-based water and hygiene intervention on child health and school attendance in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: a cluster-randomised controlled trial
pmc-11367772.creator: Sarah Bick, Alem Ezezew, Charles Opondo, Baptiste Leurent, Wossen Argaw, Erin C Hunter, Oliver Cumming, Elizabeth Allen, Robert Dreibelbis
pmc-11367772.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSchool-based water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) may improve the health and attendance of schoolchildren, particularly post-menarcheal girls, but existing evidence is mixed. We examined the impact of an urban school-based WASH programme (Project WISE) on child health and attendance.MethodsThe WISE cluster-randomised trial, conducted in 60 public primary schools in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia over one academic year, enrolled 2–4 randomly selected classes per school (~ 100 pupils) from grades 2 to 8 (aged 7–16) in an ‘open cohort’.

pmc-11493983.title: Enhancing workflow efficiency with a modified Firefly Algorithm for hybrid cloud edge environments
pmc-11493983.creator: Deafallah Alsadie, Musleh Alsulami
pmc-11493983.description: Efficient scheduling of scientific workflows in hybrid cloud-edge environments is crucial for optimizing resource utilization and minimizing completion time. In this study, we evaluate various scheduling algorithms, emphasizing the Modified Firefly Optimization Algorithm (ModFOA) and comparing it with established methods such as Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).

pmc-12602162.title: Evolutionarily New Solanaceous DCL2 Family Members Acquire Functions in Tomato
pmc-12602162.creator: Jie Hao, Junfei Ma, Bin Liu, Jernej Jakše, Ying Wang
pmc-12602162.description: RNA silencing is one of the major defence activities against viral pathogens in plants. Silencing signals are initiated by Dicer‐like proteins (DCLs) to generate viral‐derived small RNAs (sRNAs). Viral sRNAs are then loaded into Argonaute proteins to form an RNA‐induced silencing complex to guide cleavage of target RNAs based on sequence homology.

pmc-12604656.title: Racial Differences in Live-Birth Outcomes After a Breast Cancer Diagnosis
pmc-12604656.creator: Mary Kathryn Abel, Alexa Kanbergs, Chi-Fang Wu, Gabrielle Perkins, Nuria Agusti, David Viveros-Carreño, Roni Nitecki Wilke, Karla Barajas, Jose Alejandro Rauh-Hain, Alexander Melamed
pmc-12604656.description: Racial and ethnic disparities exist in subsequent live-birth rates after breast cancer. Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed cancer among women, with more than 300,000 new cases expected in 2024.1 It is the most common cancer diagnosis among women younger than 45 years old,1 making family-building considerations central to survivorship.

pmc-12971882.title: Social–Emotional Learning for students with ADHD: investigating teacher perspectives and practices
pmc-12971882.creator: Ghram A. S. Kushi, Keetam D. F. Alkahtani
pmc-12971882.description: BackgroundSocial-Emotional Learning (SEL) is a powerful approach for helping students develop essential life skills. For students with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), these skills are particularly vital. The five core competencies of SEL directly address the executive function deficits that often accompany ADHD.

pmc-13233677.title: Molecular epidemiology and clinical profiles of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales in neonates from two large children’s hospitals in southwestern China
pmc-13233677.creator: Jia Zhang, Haiping Wang, Huimin Chang, Hanyi Wang, Yinli Zhuo, Xiuyu Xu, Xuemei Zhang, Qun Zhang
pmc-13233677.description: IntroductionCarbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE) are a global health threat due to their high antimicrobial resistance and transmissibility. However, data on CRE infection in neonates in China are lacking. We collected non-duplicate CRE isolates from neonates between 2018 and 2022 in Chongqing and Kunming and investigated their antimicrobial resistance profiles, risk factors, and molecular epidemiology.MethodsAntimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using broth microdilution.

pmc-13259620.title: Pharmacological inhibition of LIF signaling reverses PD-L1-mediated immune suppression in gastric cancer
pmc-13259620.creator: Cristina Di Giorgio, Silvia Marchianò, Michele Biagioli, Ginevra Lachi, Carmen Massa, Benedetta Sensini, Eleonora Giannelli, Maria Rosaria Sette, Ginevra Urbani, Francesca Paniconi, Luigi Cari, Maria Chiara Monti, Valentina Sepe, Nicola Natalizi, Luigina Graziosi, Eleonora Distrutti, Annibale Donini
pmc-13259620.description: Highlights•LIF and PD-L1 are co-upregulated in gastric cancer tissues and immune cell subsets.•LIF triggers STAT3 signaling, driving PD-L1 transcription in gastric cancer.•The LIFR antagonist, LRI-305 reduces PD-L1 expression and epithelial–mesenchymal transition.•Blocking LIF signaling restores immune activity in the gastric tumor microenvironment.

pmc-13413215.title: Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol-Modified (PETG) as a Reusable and Biocompatible Substrate for Cell Culture Applications
pmc-13413215.creator: Alessia Vita, Federica Tiberio, Diego Sibilia, Martina Salvati, Domiziano Dario Tosi, Lorena Di Pietro, Antonio Alliva, Carlo Mariella, Ornella Parolini, Wanda Lattanzi
pmc-13413215.description: The development of reusable and biocompatible biomaterial-based culture substrates is increasingly relevant for improving sustainability in biomedical research workflows. In this study, polyethylene terephthalate glycol-modified (PETG) was evaluated as a potential alternative to conventional polystyrene (PS) for in vitro cell culture applications.
